technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum weak; price oversold on RSI-9 with rising indicators, but below key moving averages with negative MACD and below Ichimoku cloud—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MTB shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (381.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions for equities; financial sector particularly vulnerable to credit stress and volatility.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term moving average structure (SMA 50/200, EMA 50/200) remains bullish with OBV support, and extreme fear (14/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity near support level 144.97.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 381.4, rising credit spreads, inverted yield curve, strong dollar), short-term momentum is severely broken (RSI-14 at 33, MACD negative, price below EMA-9/21, Ichimoku bearish cloud), and zero fundamental conviction with no insider activity or institutional alignment.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (14/100) and long-term moving average structure offer contrarian appeal, macro crisis conditions (VIX 381.4, inverted yield curve, rising credit spreads) and broken short-term momentum (RSI-14: 33, MACD negative, price below EMA-9/21) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs support-level entry opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in acute crisis with financial sector particularly vulnerable to credit stress and volatility expansion; VIX at crisis levels suggests further equity drawdown likely before mean reversion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 30 positions in Financials (17% of portfolio); sector concentration and unfavourable macro environment warrant avoiding additional exposure despite contrarian signal.
